summary: Flee reached an unstable battle command boundary
symptom: flee helper could not move command cursor from Fight slot 0 to Run slot 3

unexpected.predicted: DOWN and RIGHT held three frames move battle command cursor to slot 3
unexpected.actual: cursor remained at slot 0 at a verified What-will-Grotle-do command boundary
diff: the initial live transition failed once; the later stable saved boundary accepts identical cursor input

hypotheses: advance_battle_until_menu accepted a transient command classification before the cursor task owned input
an unobserved emulator timing condition rejected the directional taps

solution.contract_change: All battle menu boundaries now require two stable RAM observations before input, including non-post-action entry boundaries.

targeted_checks.name: stable Sandile flee replay
targeted_checks.command: Run escape_battle twice from granite-sandile-flee-cursor-forward-20260809.state in disposable clones
targeted_checks.evidence: both escaped in one attempt with no HP/resource loss

regression_checks.name: bounded multi-encounter hunt replay
regression_checks.command: Run two disposable hunts through three non-target encounters
regression_checks.evidence: both fled all three encounters and returned clean overworld

domain_knowledge: A rendered What-will prompt may be observed during ownership transition; battle input needs a stable boundary.
tooling_contracts: Confirm every battle command boundary with two stable RAM samples before cursor input.

action_changing_unknowns: The exact pre-failure cursor ownership state was not preserved, so the one-off failure cannot yet be deterministically reproduced.

next_experiments.hypothesis: a transient command classification caused the cursor rejection
next_experiments.action: if the failure recurs, preserve the pre-cursor observation and replay its exact boundary in two clones
next_experiments.expected_discriminator: unstable menu/cursor values change during the two confirmation samples while stable values accept input
